title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: The five tires of a car (four road tires and a full-sized spare) were rotated so that each tire was used the same number of miles during the first \(30{,}000\) miles the car traveled. For how many miles was each tire used?

solutions.text:
During the \(30{,}000\) miles, \(4\) tires are always in use, so the total tire-mileage is \(4 \times 30{,}000 = 120{,}000\) tire-miles.

Split equally among \(5\) tires, each tire is used \(\dfrac{120{,}000}{5} = 24{,}000\) miles.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: At any moment \(4\) of the \(5\) tires are on the ground, so the total tire-mileage is \(4 \times 30{,}000\)
Share that total tire-mileage equally among the \(5\) tires
